$schema: Progressive Context Retrieval Gate Policy (Sanitized Reference)
purpose: Operational retrieval permission for multi-agent design-system engineering. File availability in the repository does not grant permission to load a source into the agent context.

entrypoint.broad_search_rule: Search strictly within layers granted by this policy. Matches outside granted layers require an explicit L5 forensic summons.

L0.name: Minimum active governance context
L0.purpose: Operating rules, active human decision extract, and authority manifest.

L1.name: Semantic design principles
L1.automatic_when: Current-decision extract identifies a specific visual or structural need.
L1.rule: Load only matching principle routes; avoid dumping entire design manuals into context.

L2.name: Canonical demonstrations
L2.automatic_when: L1 principles are resolved and a demonstrated compositional relationship is required.
L2.rule: Proves only its stated compositional relationship; never acts as blanket layout approval.

L3.name: System & code mapping
L3.automatic_when: Visual direction passed an explicit human approval gate or a frozen contract exists.
L3.rule: Determines how to implement an approved decision, never what the product should look like.

L4.name: Specialist & automated QA
L4.requires: Explicit task need and scoped invocation (accessibility, contrast, visual parity).
L4.rule: Subordinate to L0-L3 authority; cannot alter art direction or design tokens.

skill_isolation.default: Generic frontend/UI skills cannot inject visual judgment or override L0-L2 authority.
